subject: Commercial proposal: Holocene private deployment — platform fee & retainer options
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire@holocenehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@holocenehealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment commercial ask

Hi Avery / Sean,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Holocene is broadly aligned with Redwood on the architecture and data controls we need, but procurement has asked for a tighter breakdown on the commercials for a VPC/on-prem deployment before we can move to legal. Two specific asks: 

- A clear platform fee schedule (year 1 vs year 2+), and the impact of a 1yr vs 2yr commit.
- Any retainer/implementation credit options you can provide (we typically push some of the upfront work into a migration retainer).

Also: we need to confirm whether you can provide a limited non-production license (NFR) for our integration team during implementation — procurement expects that for on-prem installs.

Could you send an updated commercial with those line items and an initial SOW stub? We can then share with our purchasing team.

Claire
Claire Park
Head of Product Operations
Holocene Health

[Attachment: Holocene-Existing-Infra.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire@holocenehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial ask

Claire — thanks, great to meet the team yesterday. Attached is a concise commercial options worksheet and a draft SOW stub for a typical on-prem delivery. Key bullets below; numbers pulled from similar mid-market deals to make procurement arithmetic easier.

Options (platform fee = monthly, billed annually unless otherwise noted):

1) Standard 1yr commit
- Platform fee: $35,000 / month (year 1)
- Support tier: Enterprise Silver (24x5, 8-hr P1 response)
- Implementation retainer: $90,000 (one-time)
- NFR for integration: 60-day dev license included

2) Preferential 2yr commit (recommended for discount)
- Platform fee: $30,800 / month (12% discount applied to year 1 rate)
- Support tier: Enterprise Gold (24x7, 4-hr P1 response)
- Implementation retainer: $60,000 (we amortize some engineering hours into the platform fee)
- NFR for integration: 90-day dev license included + staging nodes during cutover

3) Minimal up-front (short term pilot — 6 months)
- Platform fee: $42,000 / month
- Implementation retainer: $30,000 (reduced)
- No long-term discount, limited SLA

We can also offer an implementation credit structure in lieu of a retainer: e.g., a $75k credit applied to first-year invoice if you sign a 24-month commitment. That's frequently helpful to procurement.

Attachments: Redwood-Platform-Fee-Worksheet.xlsx (line-by-line), SOW_v2.pdf (delivery milestones), Holocene-MRA.xlsx (commercial workbook template)

Next steps I suggest: you share preference between option 1 and 2; if procurement prefers a credit (the $75k) we can bake that into the term sheet and I will loop in legal for a redline-able SOW.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk the spreadsheet.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Park <claire@holocenehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@holocenehealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial ask

Thanks Avery — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and security: 

- Holocene is pushing for the 2yr commit but we need the $75k implementation credit rather than a reduced retainer line item; that makes our capital planning cleaner. Can you confirm that the credit is refundable only against year-1 platform fees and is not a cash payment?

- We require an NFR (non-production) license for 90 days for integration and an additional staging cluster during cutover — sounds like option 2 covers that but please confirm node counts for staging.

- Security asks: SOC 2 attestation (most recent) and a pen test summary. We can provide proof of environment controls on our side but procurement will not sign without those artifacts.

If you can confirm the credit mechanics and attach SOC2 + pen summary, procurement will prepare an initial PO template.

Claire

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment commercial ask

Looping Steph for approval on the credit/discount ask from Holocene. Quick notes / suggested concession: 

> From: Claire Park <claire@holocenehealth.com>
> Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial ask
> 
> - Holocene wants the $75k implementation credit (applied to Y1 invoice) and 90d NFR + staging cluster.
> - SOC2 + pen test summary required before PO.

Suggested internal approach: approve a 10% platform-fee discount (instead of full 12%) combined with a $75k implementation credit applied across the first invoice. This preserves net ARR while giving procurement the offset they want. Approve NFR and staging for the dates in the SOW. If legal needs to add a limited-use NFR clause we can pick a template.

Can we get a quick greenlight on 10% + $75k credit? If yes I will confirm with Claire and share the redlined SOW.

—Sean
Director, Enterprise Sales
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment commercial ask

Thanks for the summary. Approve the concession with one caveat: we should preserve margin and include a clawback if Holocene terminates within the first 12 months (prorated). Final position: 10% platform-fee discount for years 1-2 and a $75,000 implementation credit applied to the first-year invoice. Add a 12-month minimum term with prorated clawback on the credit if they exit early.

Also ask Legal to add the limited NFR wording (scope + non-production-only restriction) to the SOW; Avery please route to legal after you get Claire's confirmation on nodes/dates.

SG & finance are comfortable with this path — proceed and lock redlines.

—Steph
SVP, Commercial
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Claire Park <claire@holocenehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@holocenehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial ask — acceptance & next steps

Avery — thanks. Holocene accepts the 10% platform-fee discount (years 1-2) plus the $75,000 implementation credit applied to the first invoice, and the 12-month clawback language as described. We also confirm the 90-day NFR + one staging cluster (2 nodes) during cutover. Please send the redlined SOW and the PO-ready contract. Procurement will issue a PO once we have the SOC2 attestation and a pen test summary (you can redact IP-specific details).

We are ready to proceed to DocuSign for the term sheet. Please include:
- Finalized SOW_v2.pdf with node counts and milestone dates
- Term sheet with 10% discount and credit language
- DocuSign envelope link

Procurement contact: procurements@holocenehealth.com

Claire

[Attachment: PO-template-holocene.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
